Sofia, I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message so you can copy them into your note to June:

- PHL label confusion: Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark on 16 Feb.
- Moss's coverage digest says a saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals".
- The saved report label should be updated to Pellow Home Living so the old name doesn't keep showing up.

I didn't check the digest or the saved report myself, so those two points are from your message. I also didn't draft an email to June, since you asked for the bullets to be posted here.
